OFFER_AND_SUBOFFER_IDENTITY.decision: Use stable technical offer_key and suboffer_key values derived from canonical slot/profile identifiers. Presentation labels are never identifiers. Unknown, mismatched or stale keys fail closed before mutation.

PREVIEW_SNAPSHOT_AND_EXPIRY.decision: A preview is an immutable user-owned snapshot containing preview_id, user_id, offer_key, suboffer_key, class_key, generated item snapshot, quoted_price and created_at. Only one active preview per user/offer context is authoritative; cancel, replacement and expiry invalidate it without consuming a permanent ID.

PRICE_AND_GOLD_DEBIT_SNAPSHOT.decision: Confirmation uses the quoted_price stored in the preview. Sufficient gold is checked before promotion or inventory mutation. Gold debit, promotion, inventory insertion and receipt share one caller-owned Unit of Work and one commit.

INVENTORY_CAPACITY_AND_INSERTION.decision: Inventory capacity and user ownership are validated before the first mutation. A purchased promoted item is inserted exactly once with the preview's complete equipment snapshot; full inventory fails closed without debit or promotion.

PROMOTION_ATOMICITY_AND_IDEMPOTENCY.decision: Confirmation requires a stable operation_key. Same key and same preview payload replay the original receipt. Changed payload conflicts. Preview-to-permanent promotion allocates one never-reused permanent ID and commits atomically with debit and insertion; rollback leaves no partial purchase.

CONSUMER_ALLOWLIST_AND_SHADOW_OWNERS.decision: BaseEquipmentShopService is the sole V2 owner. Allowed consumers are shop presentation and explicit recovery tooling. Legacy direct trader purchase, direct SQL mutation, allocator bypass and presentation-owned mutation are forbidden production paths.

def get_common_equipment_shop_offer(user_id):
    """Формує список пропозицій магазину екіпірування для користувача."""
    from .player import get_player_level
    
    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)
    offers = []

    for slot_key in SLOT_ORDER:
        slot_name = EQUIPMENT_SLOTS.get(slot_key, slot_key)
        price = get_common_equipment_price_for_slot(player_level, slot_key)

        offers.append({
            "slot_key": slot_key,
            "slot_name": slot_name,
            "item_level": player_level,
            "price": price
        })

    return offers

def get_common_equipment_shop_suboffers(user_id, slot_key):
    """Повертає підпропозиції для конкретного слота екіпірування."""
    from .player import get_player_level
    
    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)
    price = get_common_equipment_price_for_slot(player_level, slot_key)

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        allowed_profiles = get_allowed_shop_main_hand_profiles(user_id)

        return [
            {
                "slot_key": slot_key,
                "profile_key": profile_key,
                "name": MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["name"],
                "hands": MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["hands"],
                "attack_type": MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["attack_type"],
                "item_level": player_level,
                "price": price
            }
            for profile_key in allowed_profiles
        ]

    if slot_key == "off_hand":
        allowed_profiles = get_allowed_shop_off_hand_profiles(user_id)

        return [
            {
                "slot_key": slot_key,
                "profile_key": profile_key,
                "name": OFF_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["name"],
                "hands": 1,
                "attack_type": OFF_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["attack_type"],
                "item_level": player_level,
                "price": price
            }
            for profile_key in allowed_profiles
        ]

    return []

def create_common_equipment_shop_preview(user_id, slot_key, item_profile=None):
    """
    Створює preview-предмет у таблиці items для попереднього перегляду покупки.
    """
    from systems import dynamic_equipment_system
    from systems.equipment_system import is_armor_slot
    from .equipment import init_weapon_damage_system, calculate_weapon_damage_by_values
    from .player import get_player_level
    from .inventory import get_bag_capacity, get_inventory_used_slots
    from .utils import format_gold
    from .character import get_character_class
    from data.equipment_stat_policy import redistribute_primary_stat_budget

    
    # Init systems
    try:
        dynamic_equipment_system.init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    except:
        pass
    
    init_weapon_damage_system()
    init_shop_preview_system()
    cleanup_shop_previews_for_user(user_id)

    if slot_key not in SLOT_ORDER:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Невідомий слот спорядження."
        }

    if slot_key == "main_hand" and item_profile not in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Невідомий тип зброї."
        }

    if slot_key == "off_hand" and item_profile not in OFF_HAND_PROFILES:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Невідомий тип предмета для другої руки."
        }

    if slot_key in ["main_hand", "off_hand"]:
        if not is_shop_profile_allowed_for_user(user_id, slot_key, item_profile):
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "❌ Цей предмет не підходить твоєму класу."
            }

    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)
    item_level = player_level
    rarity = "common"
    price = get_common_equipment_price_for_slot(item_level, slot_key)

    item_profile = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)

    weapon_hands = 1
    weapon_attack_type = ""
    armor_type = ""

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = profile["hands"]
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = dynamic_equipment_system.get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "weapon"

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = 1
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = dynamic_equipment_system.get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "offhand"

    else:
        item_profile = ""
        weapon_hands = 1
        armor_type = get_shop_armor_type_for_user(user_id)
        name = dynamic_equipment_system.get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
        type_ = slot_key

    name = f"{name} {item_level} рівня"

    stats = dynamic_equipment_system.generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        stats = dynamic_equipment_system.apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(
            stats=stats,
            armor_type=armor_type
        )

    # Stage 20.6.5b: the base shop is strict class-aware, including jewelry.
    # Mob loot remains identity-aware and keeps universal random jewelry stats.
    target_class = get_character_class(user_id)
    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        equipment_kind = "weapon"
    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        equipment_kind = "off_hand"
    elif slot_key in ("necklace", "ring"):
        equipment_kind = "jewelry"
    else:
        equipment_kind = "armor"
    stats = redistribute_primary_stat_budget(
        stats,
        target_class,
        equipment_kind,
        item_subtype=item_profile,
        chooser=lambda profile: random.choices(
            [stat for stat, _weight in profile],
            weights=[weight for _stat, weight in profile],
            k=1,
        )[0],
    )

    sell_price = dynamic_equipment_system.get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    weapon_min_damage = 0
    weapon_max_damage = 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

        if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
            weapon_min_magic_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_magic_damage = max_dmg
        else:
            weapon_min_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_damage = max_dmg

    item_id = allocate_shop_preview_item_id(conn)
    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        id,
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type,
        shop_preview_owner,
        shop_preview_price
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type,
        user_id,
        price
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "price": price,
        "name": name,
        "armor_type": armor_type,
        "item_subtype": item_profile
    }

def cancel_common_equipment_shop_preview(user_id, item_id):
    """Скасовує preview покупки."""
    init_shop_preview_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    DELETE FROM items
    WHERE id=?
      AND shop_preview_owner=?
      AND id NOT IN (
          SELECT item_id FROM inventory
      )
    """, (item_id, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": "❌ Купівлю скасовано."
    }

def generate_class_shop_equipment(character_class, player_level):
    """Return canonical read-only class-shop offer descriptors.

    Compatibility API only. This function does not generate random stats, create
    item rows, or create shop previews. Actual preview creation remains owned by
    create_common_equipment_shop_preview(user_id, slot_key, item_profile).
    """
    from data.equipment_stat_policy import (
        CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES,
        CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES,
        CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES,
        normalize_equipment_class,
    )

    class_key = normalize_equipment_class(character_class)
    try:
        item_level = max(1, int(player_level))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        item_level = 1

    offers = []
    armor_type = CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES[class_key]
    for slot_key in ("helmet", "shoulders", "chest", "gloves", "legs", "boots"):
        offers.append({
            "slot_key": slot_key,
            "item_profile": "",
            "armor_type": armor_type,
            "item_level": item_level,
            "rarity": "common",
            "target_class": class_key,
            "preview_api": "create_common_equipment_shop_preview",
        })

    for item_profile in CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES[class_key]:
        offers.append({
            "slot_key": "main_hand",
            "item_profile": item_profile,
            "armor_type": "",
            "item_level": item_level,
            "rarity": "common",
            "target_class": class_key,
            "preview_api": "create_common_equipment_shop_preview",
        })

    for item_profile in CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES[class_key]:
        offers.append({
            "slot_key": "off_hand",
            "item_profile": item_profile,
            "armor_type": "",
            "item_level": item_level,
            "rarity": "common",
            "target_class": class_key,
            "preview_api": "create_common_equipment_shop_preview",
        })

    return offers

def promote_shop_preview_item(conn,preview_item_id):
    preview_item_id=int(preview_item_id)
    row=conn.execute("SELECT * FROM items WHERE id=? AND shop_preview_owner IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(shop_preview_price,0)>0",(preview_item_id,)).fetchone()
    if not row: raise RuntimeError("Shop preview item not found")
    columns=[str(r[1]) for r in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(items)")]
    target=allocate_generated_item_id(conn)
    values=list(row); values[columns.index("id")]=target
    if "shop_preview_owner" in columns: values[columns.index("shop_preview_owner")]=None
    if "shop_preview_price" in columns: values[columns.index("shop_preview_price")]=0
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO items("+",".join('"'+c+'"' for c in columns)+") VALUES("+",".join('?' for _ in columns)+")",values)
    record_item_id_mapping(conn,preview_item_id,target,"shop_preview_purchase","18.1.9a")
    return target

def confirm_common_shop_purchase(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        slot_key = get_base_equipment_preview_slot_17_11_1_1(user_id, item_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, result['message'], reply_markup=trade_district_submenu_kb_17_11_1())
        text, kb = build_base_equipment_return_view_17_11_1_1(user_id, slot_key)
        bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)
